scenes.text: Which flat shape has 3 straight sides? Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is triangle. Great work!
Which flat shape has 5 straight sides? Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is pentagon. Great work!
Which flat shape has 6 straight sides? Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is hexagon. Great work!
Which flat shape has no straight sides? Let us think carefully. Count edges and vertices or look at the three-dimensional shape’s faces. The answer is circle. Great work!
